name: Brandify
summary: Managed AI-visibility agency: a monthly service that improves your pages, schema, Google Business Profile and directory listings so AI search and Google can find and cite your business, with optional visitor attribution (Reveal) and ads management.
best_for: US local and service businesses with one website that want an agency to handle Google Business Profile, directory citations, schema and new content for AI search, instead of buying a tracking tool and doing the work themselves
skip_if: you want software to track AI answers and act on them yourself, you run a multi-location, franchise, ecommerce or enterprise site (custom scope), or you need guaranteed AI citations or published cancellation terms before you sign
honest_knock: You pay for a monthly work allowance, not for results. Starter improves one existing page a month; Growth writes four pieces and Dominance eight, and other website changes wait in a queue with one active task at a time, with a 3-5 business-day target per standard task once materials and access are ready. The pricing page itself says AI mentions, rankings and lead volume vary. The pages contradict each other on Reveal: the FAQ says Growth and Dominance include it within a proposal-defined allowance, while Reveal is sold separately from $499 a month. We found no published cancellation notice or refund terms, and pricing assumes one website and one business entity.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · flat monthly service fee for one website and one primary business entity, month-to-month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-24 on brandify.io/aeo/pricing/, brandify.io/brandify-reveal/pricing/, brandify.io/pricing/ and brandify.io/aeo/faq/) Brandify sells a service, not software you log in to and run. The SEO + AEO + GEO plans are monthly and month-to-month: Starter $479 improves one existing page a month, tracks up to 10 AI-search prompts and does up to 10 directory and citation listings; Growth $799 adds four new or substantially rewritten pages or blog posts a month, up to 50 prompts and up to 50 listings, and website redesign when needed within an agreed scope (redesign pages count toward the four); Dominance $1,599 raises that to eight pieces a month and 100 prompts and includes ChatGPT ads setup and management. Every plan includes Google Business Profile management for one primary profile, Google Analytics setup and review, social post concepts (4, 8 or 12 a month), a review-request kit and review replies (up to 5, 10 or 20 a month). Pricing assumes one website and one primary business entity; multi-location, franchise, ecommerce or enterprise sites may need a custom scope. Google Search management is $250 a month plus $250 setup on every plan, ChatGPT ads management the same on Starter and Growth, and ad spend is paid separately to the platform. Brandify Reveal, a visitor-attribution and identity-resolution platform, is $499 (Starter), $799 (Growth) or $1,199 (Pro) a month, with custom pricing for Enterprise and agencies; the page says it is priced as a platform, not per lead. Audience-first advertising (CTV, display, search, social, audio, geofencing) is quoted per campaign.

compare_with.name: Superlines
compare_with.why: Superlines is in our dossiers as a tracking tool: Starter at 79 € a month for 50 prompts and one brand, read on 16 October 2026. Brandify Growth also tracks up to 50 prompts but costs $799 a month, because the fee pays for the work: four new or rewritten pages, up to 50 directory listings and Google Business Profile management. Superlines fits a team that has someone to act on the data; Brandify fits a business that wants the work done for it.
